descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software, Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for an Data Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of data integration and reporting solutions. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to ensure reliable data flows, reporting accuracy, and continuous improvement of data processes.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Develop, optimize, and maintain SQL queries across one or multiple database environments.
Design, build, and support ETL processes using tools such as Talend or similar data integration platforms.
Analyze business requirements and transform them into efficient data solutions.
Create, maintain, and enhance reporting structures and dashboards.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and performance across reporting and integration processes.
Participate in API maintenance and evolution activities, including deployments and integrations.
Troubleshoot data and reporting issues, providing timely resolutions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business and operational needs.
 Required Skills: 
Strong knowledge of SQL and experience writing complex SQL queries.
Experience working with one or more SQL database technologies.
Hands-on experience with ETL development tools, preferably Talend .
Good knowledge of reporting tools and reporting solution development.
Experience with API maintenance, deployment, or integration activities.
Understanding of REST APIs and data exchange concepts.
 Profile: 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
 Be part of a team where your expertise in ETL and reporting will contribute directly to data-driven decisions and continuous business improvement.
